body.x: XGIMI showed 'LIGHTANK W100', a business intelligence projector and 'A1Pro laser TV' at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Created by XGIMI, the W100 gives users effective office and conference room instead of a boring workload. W100 can synchronize computer screen to the projector by pressing only one key. It supports two operating systems, Windows and Mac, and provides real-time viewing of video, audio, pictures, documents, and so on.

A1Pro Laser TV is a projector that projects video of a certain size on a wall without a screen. A typical projector can be watched from a distance from the wall, however, A1Pro makes it easy for the user to watch it from close proximity to the wall. There is no need for a home cinema or installation of wires and cables to provide the same effect as installing a large screen TV.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
